column1: # Hand-verified clusters of alternative datings in the Annals of Ulster, 430-660.
# A cluster is one event (or one person's obit) for which AU offers more than one
# year.  Clusters were found two ways and pooled: (a) every entry carrying an
# alternative-source marker (src/markers.py; all 87 corpus-wide hits hand-read,
# precision 1.00) was paired with its counterpart, the automated pairing
# hand-audited in results/spread_audit.txt, and (b) for every marked entry whose
# automated partner was REJECTED, the witness was searched directly by name or
# place so that no cluster is lost to the matcher's preference for short lags.
# `years` lists every year AU assigns to the event.  `maxgap` is the largest gap
# between consecutive variant years -- the statistic that distinguishes ordinary
# annalistic scatter from two traditions merged.
